title: Hunt loot stored by Trade's receivers at Central Nexus sold where it lies
note: 2026-11-22 11:36 UTC (Mercury): orders ENT-063, block MERCURY and P5: the hunts and gift routes hand their goods to Trade's receivers; sell them where they lie at or above the standing bids. Central Nexus had no sell route for its loot. Evidence: Trade's receivers store 38 to 49 crystal melt at Central Nexus (table holdings, storage book 2026-11-22 11:32 UTC); the book bids crystal melt 3,162 x 4 (11:01 UTC), thin bids that came back hour by hour (2,733 x 1 07:59, 2,869 x 1 09:22, 3,012 x 2 10:00; the tool market), noble condensate 690 x 50. requires.stored sends only a pilot whose own storage here holds 2 crystal_melt; requires.bid closes it while a book read within the hour shows no crystal_melt bid at 2000. Floors at or under the standing bids, never under one (F12): melt 2,000 (every other melt bid but four thin ones reads 54), noble 690. Nothing is bought. A test: one ship (F37: three results decide).
